content.title: Photo introduction, decision poll and group story
content.summary: Share photos, choose a group outing and write a cumulative story in roster turns.
content.setup: Enroll a fixed roster and upload ready images through the host.
content.participant: Submit one photo, then one outing choice, then a story line on your turn.
content.completion: Photo close reveals accepted photos; organizer closes the poll; the final story turn ends the activity.
content.access: Own photos stay private until collection closes; ballots reveal when the organizer closes the poll; story lines are shared.

provenance.credit: Constructed Harmonomicon candidate 0.19 review arrangement; not source-equivalent or product-endorsed.
provenance.rights: Original review arrangement. Participant media rights and retention are host responsibilities.

steps.prompt: Add to the shared story during your turn.
